notes.title: Testing updates
notes.content:
Testing updates
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3451800761&fileuploadsuccess=1

Main game and DLC. 
Technical work is underway from 03/25/25 to 03/27/25. 
The build is large, 12.75 GB. 

[i]Includes 3 download options - do not rush to set "always download" otherwise there will be no choice of game, Option 1 - "Twilight", Option 2 - "And one day everything will change", Option 3 - "Zero1 Walk". [/i]

There are also additional components for the game "Zero1 Walk" - DirectX12, Visual C++ 2019, 2022. Do not worry, Steam will download them automatically.

You need to update, click on the gears, installed game files, check the integrity. You can also delete and download the game again.

If you accidentally clicked "Always choose this launch", you can fix it by clicking here (screenshot)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3451808502&fileuploadsuccess=1
